versions.content: {DRAFT} For each Time Base, which  has Time Validation enabled (refer to SWS_StbM_00465 ) and  is mapped to a Master on an Ethernet Time Domain, the StbM shall check within each StbM_MainFunction() , if new data has been written by StbM_EthSetPdelayResponderData() to the internal buffer for that Time Base (i.e. , the data in the buffer has not yet been passed to the application). If so, the StbM shall pass the data to the application by calling operation SetPdelayResponderData of port TimeBaseProviderNotification_Eth_{TimeBase} .

For each Time Base, wh ich  has Time Validation enabled (refer to SWS_StbM_00465 ) and  is mapped to a Master Communication Port on an Ethernet Time Domain, the StbM shall check within each StbM_MainFunction() , if new blocks (i.e., containing dat a that has not yet been passed to the application) have been written to the Pdelay Responder Validation Record Table ( Table 7 ). If so, the StbM shall pass all new blocks to the application by (repeatedly, block by block) calling operation SetPdelayResponderData of port TimeBaseProviderNotification_Eth_{TimeBase} . The StbM shall pass the blocks starting with the block containing the oldest data and followed by the blocks in ascending order regarding their age (i.e., FIFO order). The block containing the newest data shall be passed last.
